snapshot_integration_rule: Every snapshot_inventory ID must be searchable, either in a release-event record or as an explicit alias/child snapshot. An alias is not an extra trained model. Unknown exact release dates must remain undated.
coverage_notes: Counts of IDs and snapshots are not counts of unique trained models. Aliases and simultaneous initial snapshots should be searchable without creating misleading extra model totals.

Exactly four current catalog identities have no verified initial release date in this audit: GPT-Audio, GPT-4o Transcribe Diarize, text-moderation-latest, and text-moderation-stable. All four are retained in the known-model inventory.

Additional named models missing from the current catalog but found in official sources include GPT-5-Codex-Mini, GPT-5 Search API, GPT-5.3 Instant Mini, GPT-5.1 Pro, Cyber5.4/5.5, GPT-Live mini, and safeguard sizes.
Sora2-2025-12-08 is a known snapshot; January13/2026 changelog documents alias update, not proof of its first December8 availability. Its release date stays unknown.
DALL-E2 April6/2022 is an official system-card as-of availability anchor, not independently proven first launch day. Preserve the qualification.
Do not collapse month precision to day1. Whisperlarge-v2 has month-level release evidence and separate repository/announcement event dates.
Official modelcatalog is not an inventory of every research-only model. Optional research candidates are documented separately; they are not silently declared covered.

integration_contract.proposed_records: Candidate dated additions and explicit named snapshot records. Deduplicate against exact existing names, current aliases, and shared releaseevents. A modelalias is not an additional trainedmodel. Keys beyond m,d,lane,t,n,s are auditmetadata.
integration_contract.existing_record_audit: 62 baseline rows. Use verified source and datekind notes. The existing date is not necessarily APIlaunch; preserve stagedrelease semantics.
integration_contract.unresolved: Required searchable undated inventory; never assign an invented date to satisfy timelinebuild validation.
integration_contract.snapshot_inventory: 114 exact identifiers with parent model and sources. Include every identifier via alias, childsnapshot, or separate datedrelease record.
integration_contract.verification_mapping: Repo schema currently accepts only omitted or unverified; translate audit verification labels rather than copying verified strings blindly.
integration_contract.corrections: Apply with preservation of oldname aliases and release-stage distinction.
